annual_rate.notes: Post-judgment interest at North Carolina’s legal rate of 8% per annum — N.C.G.S. §24-5 pegs judgment interest to the §24-1 legal rate (8%), or the contract rate for judgments on a contract. Fixed by statute; simple interest. Verify against the statute; not legal advice.
